'''Sensi''' (Senti, Tenti, Mananahua) is an extinct [[Panoan language]], spoken on the right bank of the [[Ucayali River]], [[Peru]].<ref>{{cite book|title=International Encyclopedia of Linguistics: AAVE - Esperanto|date=2003|publisher=Oxford University Press|isbn=9780195139778|page=234|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=sl_dDVctycgC&q=Sensi+language+panoan&pg=RA2-PA233|language=en}}</ref> It disappeared around the mid-20th century.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Fleck |first=David |date=2020-06-14 |title=Los Sensi de la Familia Pano |url=http://amazoniaperuana.caaap.org.pe/index.php/amazoniaperuana/article/view/22 |journal=Amazonía Peruana |issue=33 |pages=109–146 |doi=10.52980/revistaamazonaperuana.vi33.22 |issn=0252-886X|doi-access=free }}</ref>
